title: The Lumley Autograph
author: Susan Fenimore Cooper
description: "The Lumley Autograph" by Susan Fenimore Cooper is a satirical novella published in the mid-19th century.
longDescription: This work addresses the autograph collecting craze of the time, exploring themes of ambition, poverty, and the sometimes absurd nature of literary fame.

authorInfo.bio: Susan Fenimore Cooper (1813–1894) wrote The Lumley Autograph. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
